'''Harvest Island''' (Japanese: '''ミノリ島''' ''Minori Island'') is the tenth island {{Ash}} and {{Ashfr}} traveled on in the [[Decolore Islands]].

The island is famous for its [[Berry]] trees and produce. It features many sweeping green hills and has a township close to its shipping dock. The island is also known for the [[Grand Harvest Festival]], a celebration of its history, which includes a [[Pokémon Sumo Tournament]].

While on Harvest Island, the group met [[Alexa]], a journalist from the [[Kalos]] [[region]]. Before the Pokémon Sumo Tournament, {{Ash}} met another Trainer named [[Rodney]], who he quickly became rivals with after they bumped into each other. In the end, Ash became the Pokémon Sumo Tournament's winner.
